title: Stale output contamination / stod parse failure
symptom: A run reads old outputs from a previous run, or ABACUS/LibRPA fails with a stod (string-to-double) parse/read error on an input or output file.
root_cause: Stale-output contamination from previous runs, or inputs mixed from different workflow chains with mismatched parameter spellings (e.g. the deprecated cs_inv_thr key instead of exx_cs_inv_thr).
minimal_fix: Run in a fresh immutable run directory. Before treating a failure as a physics/input issue, check for stale files and mixed input chains. Replace the deprecated cs_inv_thr with exx_cs_inv_thr; run the compatibility audit first when ABACUS reports 'THE PARAMETER NAME ... IS INCORRECT!'.
validation: Re-run in a clean directory; the input parse and read succeed with no stale files.
avoid: Reusing a run directory across producer stages; keeping deprecated key spellings that the current binary rejects.
source: abacus-librpa-debug skill (diagnosis order step 4, stod); oh-my-librpa debug-route and abacus-merge-compat references.
